read.en: Bloom Energy fell 11.2% on Oct 23 to $193.30, trading between $189.00 and $205.99 on 2.5 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($219.7), 10-day ($232.1), 30-day ($262.0) and 100-day ($248.4) averages and the rising 200-day ($219.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($251.07), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月23日下跌 11.2%，收于 $193.30，盘中区间 $189.00–205.99，成交量为平均水平的 2.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$219.7）、10 日（$232.1）、30 日（$262.0）和 100 日均线（$248.4）以及上行的 200 日均线（$219.3）下方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图再度扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$251.07），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The drop broke the $210.7–213.1 and $197.5 (Sep 1 low) supports, now resistance. Resistance is $197.5, then $206–213 (Oct 23 high, Oct 20 and 22 lows) and $219.3–219.7 (200 and 5-day). Support is $185.9–189 (Aug 24 low, Oct 23 low), then $157.3 (Jul 29 low). A close back above $197.5 would target $206–213; a close below $185.9 would open $157.
